assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The appeal concerns CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The documented diagnosis codes are I49.5 and I48.0
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
The note states that continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management
The denial is based on an authorization-based denial
The appeal requests reconsideration on the basis of documented medical necessity for CPT 93229
